name: Denmark
note: A doctor performs the ligsyn and issues the death certificate electronically; unnatural or unexplained deaths go first to the police for a forensic ligsyn. The same doctor notifies the parish registrar electronically within two working days, so families have no registration duty, although they request the burial through a digital service. The death is entered in the Central Person Register (CPR), from which authorities such as Udbetaling Danmark and the Tax Agency draw it automatically. Businesses, including banks and insurers, can subscribe to CPR updates on people they have identified.

citations.title: Dødens konstatering
citations.quote: En persons død kan konstateres ved uopretteligt ophør af åndedræt og hjertevirksomhed eller ved uopretteligt ophør af al hjernefunktion.

citations.title: Ligsyn
citations.quote: Ligsyn foretages af en læge til afgørelse af, om dødsfald er indtrådt.

citations.title: Ligsyn (afdødes sædvanlige læge)
citations.quote: I andre tilfælde skal ligsyn foretages af afdødes sædvanlige læge eller dennes stedfortræder.

citations.title: Indberetning til politiet
citations.quote: Den læge, der tilkaldes i anledning af dødsfald, skal afgive indberetning til politiet,

citations.title: Retslægeligt ligsyn
citations.quote: I de tilfælde, der er nævnt i § 179, iværksættes retslægeligt ligsyn.

citations.title: Retslægeligt ligsyn (udførelse)
citations.quote: Retslægeligt ligsyn foretages af politiet og Styrelsen for Patientsikkerhed i forening.

citations.title: Dødsattest
citations.quote: Når ligsyn er afsluttet, skal lægen udstede dødsattest.

citations.title: Dødsattest (begravelse)
citations.quote: Liget må ikke begraves, brændes eller føres ud af landet, førend dødsattest er udstedt.

citations.title: Elektronisk dødsattest
citations.quote: Dødsattest udfærdiges og indsendes elektronisk i overensstemmelse med Sundhedsstyrelsens vejledning om udfyldelse og indberetning af dødsattester.

citations.cite: Bekendtgørelse om anmeldelse af dødsfald (BEK nr. 1145 af 30/09/2010), § 1
citations.title: Frister og myndigheder
citations.quote: skal senest 2 hverdage efter dødsfaldet eller efter skibets eller luftfartøjets ankomst til dansk område anmeldes til personregisterføreren for det sogn, hvor afdøde havde bopæl

citations.title: Anmeldelsens afgivelse
citations.quote: Anmeldelsen foretages af den dødsattestudstedende læge.

citations.title: Anmeldelsens afgivelse (SEI)
citations.quote: Indberetningen af dødsfaldet skal ske i Sundhedsstyrelsens Elektroniske Indberetningssystem (SEI).

citations.cite: Lov om begravelse og ligbrænding (LBK nr. 766 af 12/06/2023), § 5
citations.title: Anmodning om begravelse og ligbrænding
citations.quote: Anmodning om foretagelse af begravelse eller ligbrænding fremsættes over for begravelsesmyndigheden

citations.cite: Lov om begravelse og ligbrænding, § 5 a
citations.title: Digital selvbetjening
citations.quote: Anmodning om foretagelse af begravelse eller ligbrænding skal ske ved anvendelse af den digitale løsning, som Kirkeministeriet stiller til rådighed (digital selvbetjening).

citations.title: Offentlige myndigheders indhentning
citations.quote: Når en offentlig myndighed har brug for oplysninger, som er registreret i CPR, kan myndigheden indhente oplysningerne i CPR

citations.title: Oplysninger i CPR (abonnement)
citations.quote: De myndigheder og private, som efter henholdsvis §§ 32 og 38 abonnerer på ajourførte oplysninger fra CPR

citations.title: Videregivelse til private
citations.quote: at få leveret oplysninger i CPR om en større afgrænset kreds af personer, som de pågældende forud har identificeret enkeltvis

citations.title: Videregivelse til private (død)
citations.quote: eventuel død, datoen for dødsfaldet og afdødes daværende adresse, medmindre denne er beskyttet

citations.title: Forsikringsselskaber og pensionskasser
citations.quote: ved registrering i CPR af vedkommendes død tillige oplysning om navn og adresse på afdødes ægtefælle eller registrerede partner

citations.title: Enkeltforespørgsler
citations.quote: Enhver har ret til ved henvendelse til en kommunalbestyrelse at få oplysninger i CPR om en bestemt person, som den pågældende forud har identificeret

citations.title: Andre myndigheders deltagelse i vedligeholdelsen af CPR
citations.quote: Andre myndigheder deltager i vedligeholdelsen af CPR i overensstemmelse med regler fastsat af vedkommende minister

citations.title: Registrering i CPR med oplysningerne i bilag 1 (herunder død)
citations.quote: registreres i CPR med de oplysninger, der er anført i bilag 1 til loven

citations.cite: Lov nr. 249 af 23/03/2010 om ændring af lov om anmeldelse af fødsler og dødsfald, § 1, nr. 1 (ændrer § 1 i lov nr. 225 af 31/05/1968)
citations.title: Dødsfald anmeldes til Den Elektroniske Kirkebog og CPR
citations.quote: I § 1 ændres »folkekirkens ministerialbøger« til: »Den Elektroniske Kirkebog og CPR«.

citations.title: Lægens anmeldelsespligt
citations.quote: Den læge, der udfærdiger dødsattesten, skal anmelde dødsfaldet gennem sundhedsvæsenets it-systemer.

citations.cite: Vejledning om folkeregistrering (VEJ nr. 9806 af 26/10/2023), kap. 1
citations.title: Sognene registrerer dødsfald i CPR
citations.quote: grundregistrerende myndigheder, f.eks. af Familieretshuset i visse sager om forældremyndighed, og sognene i sager om fødsler og dødsfald i Danmark

citations.cite: Vejledning om folkeregistrering (VEJ nr. 9806 af 26/10/2023), indledning
citations.title: Personregisterføreren registrerer i CPR
citations.quote: udtrykket personregisterføreren anvendes i vejledningen om den myndighedsperson, der registrerer oplysningerne i CPR

steps.title: A doctor performs the ligsyn to establish death
steps.who: In hospital, a doctor who treated the patient; elsewhere the deceased's usual doctor or deputy, and no local doctor may refuse if they are unavailable.
steps.summary: At the ligsyn the doctor observes the signs of death and, as far as possible, establishes manner and cause of death.

steps.title: Doctor reports unnatural or unexplained deaths to the police
steps.who: The doctor called to the death; in hospital, the senior doctor.
steps.trigger: Crime, suicide, accident, a person found dead, sudden unforeseen death, possible occupational disease or treatment error, death in prison, or other police interest.
steps.summary: In these cases the doctor must report to the police instead of simply certifying.

steps.title: Police and the patient-safety authority hold a forensic ligsyn
steps.who: The police and Styrelsen for Patientsikkerhed jointly.
steps.trigger: A death reported under § 179, unless obviously natural or without police interest.
steps.summary: The death certificate is then issued by the doctor who took part, and needs the police endorsement before burial, cremation or removal abroad.

steps.title: Doctor issues the death certificate electronically
steps.who: The doctor who performed the ligsyn; submitted to the national health authorities (Sundhedsstyrelsen's reporting system).
steps.summary: The death certificate is completed and submitted electronically. Burial, cremation or removal abroad cannot happen until it is issued.

steps.title: The certifying doctor notifies the parish registrar within two working days
steps.who: The doctor who issued the death certificate, to the personregisterfører of the deceased's parish (in South Jutland, the municipality).

deadline.text: no later than 2 working days after the death

steps.summary: The notification is made in the health authority's electronic reporting system (SEI); a paper form is used only where the deceased had no Danish personal number.

steps.title: Burial or cremation is requested digitally from the burial authority
steps.who: The next of kin, those who cared for the deceased, or others; failing them, the municipality.
steps.summary: Requests must use the Church Ministry's digital self-service solution unless the burial authority accepts another form for special reasons.

steps.title: The death is entered in CPR
steps.who: The personregisterfører of the parish (in South Jutland, the municipality) that received the death notification.
steps.summary: The 1968 Act on notification of births and deaths, as amended in 2010, has deaths notified to 'Den Elektroniske Kirkebog og CPR'; CPR-loven lets other authorities maintain CPR under their minister's rules, and the Interior Ministry's guidance names the parishes as the bodies registering deaths in CPR. No time limit for the entry was found.
steps.latencyNote: ingen frist for registreringen i CPR (lov249-1-1; cpr-2-2)

steps.title: Udbetaling Danmark and other authorities draw the death from CPR
steps.who: Public authorities, including Udbetaling Danmark, which may subscribe to updated CPR data.
steps.latencyNote: ingen frist; vilkår fastsættes af ministeriet (cpr-32)
steps.summary: A public authority that needs data registered in CPR can obtain it there, including as a subscription to updated data.

steps.title: The Tax Agency draws the death from CPR
steps.who: Skattestyrelsen, as a public authority using CPR.
steps.latencyNote: ingen frist; vilkår fastsættes af ministeriet (cpr-32)
steps.summary: Same legal route as other authorities.

steps.title: Anyone can learn from the municipality whether an identified person has died
steps.who: Anyone who identifies the person; enquiry to a municipal council.
steps.summary: The information available includes the fact and date of death and the last address, unless protected.

steps.title: Businesses can subscribe to CPR updates, including death
steps.who: Companies and other businesses that have identified the persons in advance (for example banks).
steps.latencyNote: løbende ændringer; ingen frist i loven (cpr-38-2)
steps.summary: The Ministry supplies name, address, death and date of death, and later changes, for a defined group of identified persons.

steps.title: Insurers and pension funds also receive the surviving spouse's details on death
steps.who: Insurance companies, pension funds and banks administering pension savings.
steps.trigger: Registration of the death in CPR.
steps.latencyNote: ved registrering i CPR af vedkommendes død; ingen frist (cpr-38-3)
steps.summary: On top of the general data, they get civil status and, when a death is registered, the name and address of the spouse or registered partner.

registrationDeadlineDays.note: Two working days after the death; the doctor notifies, not the family.

informantDuty.note: The doctor who issues the death certificate makes the notification.

medicalExaminerScrutiny.note: No independent review of every certificate: the forensic ligsyn by police and Styrelsen for Patientsikkerhed is limited to reported deaths.

electronicRegistration.note: Both the death certificate and the death notification are electronic; paper only for persons without a Danish personal number or by exception.

governmentPropagation.note: Authorities obtain CPR data directly and can subscribe to updates.

certificateAccess.note: Anyone who identifies a person can ask a municipality for CPR data, including death, its date and the last address. Access to the death certificate itself was not established.

privateSectorVerification.note: Businesses can subscribe to CPR updates on identified people, including death; insurers and pension funds also receive the surviving spouse's details.

gaps: The 1968 Act (lov nr. 225) itself has no text on retsinformation; its § 1 as amended was read through the 2010 amending Act (lov nr. 249) and the comparison column of its bill (2009/1 LSF 68), which gives the original § 1 as 'skal anmeldes til folkekirkens ministerialbøger'. No Kirkeministeriet order setting a time for the personregisterfører's CPR entry was found, so dk-cpr's latency is unspecified.
Lov nr. 225 af 31/05/1968 om anmeldelse af fødsler og dødsfald is cited only through its 2010 amendment and the 2010 executive order made under it (BEK 1145/2010, which retsinformation marks Valid).
CPR-loven is cited as LBK 1010/2023, which retsinformation marks Valid; several later amending acts (2023-2025) are listed against it and were not checked for changes to §§ 32, 38 and 42.

Where the electronic death certificate goes (Sundhedsdatastyrelsen's cause-of-death register) is not stated in the executive order; the dk-attest step therefore targets other-government, and no statistics step is recorded.
Who may obtain a copy of the dødsattest was not established; certificateAccess rests on the CPR enquiry right in § 42.

CPR-loven § 38 (the brief's reference) gives private bodies a CPR subscription; "kreditinstitutter" are not named specifically, though § 38(3) names insurers, pension funds and banks for pension savings.
